Lydian.cinematic_archetype: Wonder, Cosmic Ascent, Celestial Magic, Hopeful Flight
Lydian.avoidance_rule: Avoid resolving #4 directly down to 3; emphasize Major II chord to highlight #4.

Ionian.cinematic_archetype: Triumph, Pastoral Joy, Heroic Resolution, Sunlight
Ionian.avoidance_rule: Avoid lingering on degree 4 (unresolved tritone against 7).

Mixolydian.cinematic_archetype: Swashbuckling Adventure, Celtic Folk, Open Seas, Friendly Rivalry
Mixolydian.avoidance_rule: Avoid classical V7-I cadence; use bVII-I or v-I modal cadences.

Dorian.cinematic_archetype: Noble Melancholy, Ancient Warriors, Cyberpunk Mystery, Resolute Heroism
Dorian.avoidance_rule: Feature IV major chord (containing natural 6) resolving to i minor.

Aeolian.cinematic_archetype: Tragedy, Somber Reflection, Epic Loss, Winter Wilderness
Aeolian.avoidance_rule: Avoid V7 dominant chord (which forces classical harmonic minor leading tone).

Phrygian.cinematic_archetype: Dark Mysticism, Ancient Pyramids, Scorched Desert, Ominous Threat
Phrygian.avoidance_rule: Feature bII -> i cadence; avoid major 6th degrees.

Locrian.cinematic_archetype: Abyssal Terror, Psychological Madness, Eldritch Dread, Unstable Core
Locrian.avoidance_rule: Avoid attempting to establish stable tonic; use as tension transition zone.

Hirajoshi.cinematic_archetype: Melancholy, Edo Japan, Introspective Solitude, Moonlit Stealth

Insen.cinematic_archetype: Traditional Drama, Tension, Twilight Meditation, Martial Arts Focus
Insen.avoidance_rule: Emphasize root-b2 tension against open fifth.

Hungarian_Minor.cinematic_archetype: Gothic Horror, Vampiric Aristocracy, Occult Rituals, Dramatic Sorrow
Hungarian_Minor.avoidance_rule: Emphasize augmented 2nd melodic intervals (b3 to #4, and b6 to 7).

Whole_Tone.cinematic_archetype: Dream Sequence, Time Warp, Amnesia, Subaquatic Hallucination
Whole_Tone.avoidance_rule: Has no tonic hierarchy; modulate by transposition steps (+1 or -1).

Octatonic_HW.cinematic_archetype: Lovecraftian Cosmic Dread, High-Stakes Boss Combat, Stravinsky Rhythms
Octatonic_HW.avoidance_rule: Alternate strictly between half and whole steps.

Acoustic_Scale.cinematic_archetype: Lydian Dominant, Mystical Flight, Whimsical Sci-Fi, Debussy Magic
Acoustic_Scale.avoidance_rule: Balance #4 brightness with b7 bluesy subtonic.
